title: Quiet : The Power of Introverts in a World That Can't Stop Talking
author: Susan Cain
summary: Susan Cain argues that modern workplaces and schools favour extroverts and overlook what quieter people offer. She mixes research on temperament with stories and advice for introverts and those who live with them.
readIf: you are an introvert or care for one and want to see it described with respect.
skipIf: you want a rigorous psychology text, since the book leans on anecdote and popular summary.
